newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 firms at open, awaiting U.S. PPI data.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 firms at open, awaiting U.S. PPI data.

text.p: UK shares firmed in early trading on Friday, with the FTSE 100 climbing back above the 4,000 level, as gilts pare initial losses.
AT 0746 GMT, the FTSE 100 was up 8.0 points at 4,002.7.
But gains may be limited ahead of the release of key inflation data from the U.S., traders said.
"I think people are going to use the figures as an excuse not to do anything," said one trader.
The U.S. producer price index for September, due for release at 1230 GMT, is expected to show a 0.3 percent rise, according to economists surveyed by Reuters.
